name: How much does drywall texture repair cost, and what makes the price go up?

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall texture repair cost, and what makes the price go up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs depend on the size of the repair, the texture style, ceiling height, and whether prep work or repainting is needed. Small repairs are usually much less expensive than full-room texture work, but exact pricing is hard to estimate without seeing the damage. If you want value, compare more than the price: ask whether the estimate includes patching, texture matching, cleanup, and primer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on patch size, texture type, prep, and repainting. Small fixes cost less, while matching complex textures or repairing water damage costs more.
